description: On-device tcc COMPILE (P3b-2a): the Dunit tcc (/system/bin/tcc) compiles a C source ON the kernel. `tcc -c /assets/tcc/probe.c -o /tmp/probe.o` runs tcc's full pipeline (preprocess/parse/codegen/write object) — no sysroot needed (the source has no #include and -c does not link). `ls /tmp` then shows probe.o, proving the object was written. Run: tools/qemu_test.py --build --markers-file tools/m6_tcc_compile_markers.json --post-boot-delay 3 --settle 4 --cmd-timeout 45 --timeout 300 --boot-timeout 180

required.claim: tcc compiled the source and exited cleanly on-device
tcc wrote the ELF object to /tmp — codegen + object emission work on-device

forbidden.why: tcc failed to compile the source on-device
